record.rationale: Contains React or browser DOM adaptation behind Writer command and model boundaries; no native LibreOffice source file is claimed as its owner.
responsibilities: Renders the bounded Writer Format popup and pinned Bullets and Numbering submenu at the LibreOffice `sw/uiconfig/swriter/menubar/menubar.xml` ownership boundary.
Renders the implemented Writer commands in their pinned LibreOffice menu locations without copying native menu visuals.

Keeps top-level and nested command popups inside the browser viewport, with internal scrolling, above/below placement and submenu edge flipping following inspected VCL screen-bounded behavior; browser geometry does not certify native timers, scroller visuals or full menu parity.

Existing nested popup consumes keyboard input only in the nearest owning popup: one Enter/Space dispatch and one prefix append per key. Owned regression and real Chromium Writer ruler toggle evidence cover this bounded adapter contract; complete native menu/mnemonic behavior remains unverified.

Existing pointer submenu opening focuses its popup without item preselection; keyboard opening preselects the first item. Unselected popup boundary navigation and no-command Return dismissal are covered with owned cases and real Chromium Writer interaction. Native popup/window focus maps to DOM popup/item focus; full disabled traversal defaults, pointer timers and mnemonics remain unverified.

Existing root pointer opening focuses the unselected popup; keyboard Up/Down/Return opening preselects its first eligible entry, with Space retained as the browser activation adapter. Active-popup reuse and one-shot focus requests preserve current child selection and later resource rerenders. Owned regressions and actual Chromium Status Bar toggles cover this bounded contract; saved document focus, platform disabled traversal, F10/Alt, mnemonics and native pointer timers remain unverified.

Existing menus retain a connected external DOM focus owner across root/submenu changes and restore it on root cancellation or before command dispatch. Command teardown synchronously unmounts popup controls before Execute, preserving focus acquired by a new dialog. Focus transfer outside cancels without restoring over its new owner. Owned callback-time popup/focus assertions and actual Chromium Writer editor/dialog/control checks cover this bounded lifecycle; no-owner native document fallback, global/frame focus flags and full native focus graph remain unverified.

Unopened activated menubar Escape defaults to its Writer frame client when no connected external owner is saved; a live saved owner takes precedence. The browser view supplies its own mounted editing-host reference, keeping DOM out of core and avoiding document-wide selectors. Owned per-frame/disconnected-owner cases and Chromium focus-plus-editing checks cover this branch only; no-owner popup cleanup, frame/global native flags and full menu parity remain unverified.

Unmodified F10 activates the first root without opening a popup, and repeats to deactivate an active menubar or popup with saved-owner/default-client focus restoration and no command dispatch. An explicit activation flag follows the inspected native highlight-valid cycle. The Writer view grants this browser key route only to an active input-enabled frame outside its existing modal dialogs; detached presenters require explicit eligibility. Owned cycle/frame/modifier cases and actual Chromium editing, toolbar-owner and modal focus checks cover this bounded contract. Modified keys remain on their existing command/browser route (native Ctrl-F10 belongs to .uno:ControlCodes). Complete accelerator priority, Alt/mnemonics, F6, platform/system menus, no-owner popup fallback and the full native focus graph remain unverified.

Existing root Left/Right/Home/End navigation now shares one selection path. An already open popup follows the selected boundary root with keyboard first-item preselection and former child-popup teardown; inactive auto-popup stays closed. Same-root popup reuse and later resource reprojection retain selection without a new preselection request. Owned boundary/root/child/arrow-wrap/saved-owner cases and actual Chromium popup replacement, no-popup F10 navigation and focus-plus-editing cover this contract only. Full F6 pane traversal, Sidebar deck focus composition, native hidden/disabled/global/platform defaults, Alt/mnemonics and full menu parity remain unverified.

Iteration168 removes presentation descriptor-presence filtering for supported generated menu resources; inactive native shell commands retain their resource entries and become disabled through existing Sfx bindings, matching pinned MenuBarManager DontHideDisabledEntry=true default. No new registration fallback or command model; other native framework behavior remains unverified.

stackDivergence.rationale: Browser DOM and React replace the native VCL presentation boundary.
